span.p:
⚡ Alloy Agent (Host Local)
• privileged: true
• Lê /proc, /sys, /rootfs
• Coleta Journald e Docker Socket

span.p:
🚪 Alloy Gateway
• privileged: false (Unprivileged)
• Portas: 4317 (gRPC), 4318 (HTTP), 9998 (Loki), 9999 (Mimir)
• Autenticação, Relabel e Fan-out de Telemetria
